title: 第25章 恶人谷的老兵第26章 山寨的威胁
content_zh:
“呜呼呼！原来这就是飞的感觉吗！真的太舒服了！”郑元雪和杨修骑在蛟龙背上，显然郑元雪特别的激动。
杨修看到郑元雪如此的兴奋无奈的开口“你不要动的太厉害了，以免掉下去！”
“不会！不会！就算我掉下去小蛟龙也会接住我的！对吧小蛟龙！”郑元雪兴奋的回答道，随后用手拍了拍努力飞行的小蛟龙。
“你放心你掉下去我绝对不会接住你的！”蛟龙乐呵呵的开口道。
“你这么兴奋知道我们到哪里了？”杨修淡淡的开口道。
“一直往西走的地图没有作用了，所以我也不知道在哪里！随缘喽！”郑元雪兴奋的伸展的双臂大笑的开口道。
“唉！好吧好吧！我唔～”杨修开口但是话没说完便被打断了，此时身下的小蛟龙身体晃动了一下，杨修还好只是颠簸一下，郑元雪因为双手闲空差点没掉下去。
“小蛟龙你？”郑元雪不满用手揪着蛟龙开口但是话没说完便被打断了，因为蛟龙又晃动了一下。
“怎么有什么不对劲的嘛小蛟龙？”杨修发现蛟龙的开口问道。
“下面有人射箭！”蛟龙喘着气开口道。
“先下去吧！你也飞了很长时间了！”杨修拍了拍小蛟龙的背让它降落，郑元雪想开口发觉小蛟龙好像确实飞了漫长时间的便忍住了。
蛟龙听到杨修的话，直接俯身下落，没过一会，便落到了地上在他们面前是一处盆地，在盆地的入口处有一道山门，山门上写着三个大字恶人谷。
还没等杨修三人上前，山门便打开了，一队身着简易盔甲的人走了出来，对杨修三人充满着敌意。
“你们是谁？为什么飞在我们营地上空？”恶人谷来人中一个长相粗犷的汉子开口对着杨修三人道。
杨修听到三人的话再看他们紧握武器的双手知道他们很紧张便开口“你们不要紧张我们只是想往西出发去镇西关路过你们营地而已！”
“对对对，我们没有恶意的！”不知道为何郑元雪在杨修说完也开了口。
“杨哥！他们看着没有恶意怎么说？”站在粗犷男子身侧的一名瘦弱的男子开口问道。
“我在确定一下！有只蛟龙当宠兽身份肯定不简单！”果然粗犷男子在发现杨修三人并未有敌意便深深松了一口气，“你们叫什么从哪里来的？”
“我和他从王都来的，我叫郑元雪，这只蛟龙是我们路上遇到的！”还没有等杨修开口郑元雪便迫不及待的开口，杨修侧目看了一眼郑元雪不知道为什么这么反常，郑元雪这个人平时警惕性挺强的，现在怎么一股脑的说了出来。
“你今天很反常！”杨修还是没有忍住内心的疑问小声的对郑元雪开口。

郑元雪没有开口只是一脸自信的看着对面的人，谁知当郑元雪报完名字之后原本有点放松的杨佳运等人再次握紧了手中的兵器。
“你是皇室中人？”杨佳运冷冷的开口道语气中带着丝丝杀意。
本来一脸自信的郑元雪看到杨佳运等人的动作表情的自信也没有了，反倒是一脸尴尬的看着杨修。
content_en:
"Wow! So this is what flying feels like! It's so comfortable!" Zheng Yuanxue and Yang Xiu rode on the back of the dragon. Zheng Yuanxue was obviously very excited.
Seeing Zheng Yuanxue so excited, Yang Xiu said helplessly, "Don't move too much, or you'll fall!"
"No! No! Even if I fall, the little dragon will catch me! Right, little dragon!" Zheng Yuanxue replied excitedly, and then patted the little dragon that was flying hard.
"Don't worry, I will never catch you if you fall!" Jiaolong said cheerfully.
"Are you so excited to know where we are?" Yang Xiu said lightly.
"The map that goes all the way to the west doesn't work anymore, so I don't know where it is! Just let it happen!" Zheng Yuanxue said with a laugh and stretched out her arms in excitement.
"Oh! Okay, okay! I uh~" Yang Xiu started but was interrupted before he could finish his words. At this time, the body of the little dragon beneath him shook. Fortunately, Yang Xiu only had a bump. Zheng Yuanxue almost didn't fall because his hands were free.
"You little Jiaolong?" Zheng Yuanxue was dissatisfied and grabbed Jiaolong with her hands and spoke, but was interrupted before she could finish her words because Jiaolong shook again.
"What's wrong, little Jiaolong?" Yang Xiu noticed Jiaolong's voice and asked.
"There are people shooting arrows below!" Jiaolong gasped and said.
"Get down first! You've been flying for a long time!" Yang Xiu patted the little dragon on the back and let it land. Zheng Yuanxue wanted to speak but she realized that the little dragon seemed to have flown for a long time, so she held it back.
When Jiaolong heard Yang Xiu's words, he leaned down and fell to the ground after a while. In front of them was a basin. At the entrance of the basin, there was a mountain gate with three large characters written on it: Valley of the Wicked.
Before Yang Xiu and the others could step forward, the mountain gate opened, and a group of people in simple armor came out, full of hostility towards Yang Xiu and the others.
"Who are you? Why are you flying over our camp?" A rough-looking man from the Evil Valley said to Yang Xiu and the others.
When Yang Xiu heard what the three said, he looked at their hands clenching weapons and knew that they were nervous, so he said, "Don't be nervous, we just want to set off to the west to Zhenxiguan and pass by your camp!"
"Yes, yes, we don't mean any harm!" I don't know why Zheng Yuanxue also spoke after Yang Xiu finished speaking.
"Brother Yang! How can you say they don't look malicious?" A thin man standing beside the rugged man asked.
"I'm making sure! It's definitely not easy to have a dragon as a pet!" Sure enough, the rugged man breathed a deep sigh of relief when he discovered that Yang Xiu and the others were not hostile, "What did you call them? Where did they come from?"
"He and I came from the royal capital. My name is Zheng Yuanxue. We met this dragon on the road!" Zheng Yuanxue couldn't wait to speak before Yang Xiu could speak. Yang Xiu glanced sideways at Zheng Yuanxue and didn't know why it was so abnormal. Zheng Yuanxue was usually very vigilant, but now he said it out loud.
"You are unusual today!" Yang Xiu still couldn't hold back the doubts in his heart and whispered to Zheng Yuanxue.
Zheng Yuanxue did not speak but looked at the person opposite with a confident face. Unexpectedly, when Zheng Yuanxue finished announcing her name, Yang Jiayun and others who were originally a little relaxed clenched the weapons in their hands again.
"Are you from the royal family?" Yang Jiayun said coldly with a hint of murderous intent in his tone.
Zheng Yuanxue, who was originally confident, lost her confidence when she saw the movements and expressions of Yang Jiayun and others. Instead, she looked at Yang Xiu with an embarrassed look.
